options.label: Thinking
options.help: Off: it never calls Claude. Powers, body and menu still work.

options.label: Answer every message
options.help: On: every chat message wakes it, not just ones naming it or praying. Livelier, but it thinks far more often.

options.label: Always answer
options.help: On: whoever speaks to it always gets words back, even a refusal. Off: it may stay silent.

options.label: Silence for the hated
options.help: With always-answer on, it may still ignore mortals this hated or worse (-11: it answers everyone).

options.label: Goals & missions
options.help: It keeps goals of its own and sets missions for mortals, so it is never merely there.

options.label: Goals at once
options.help: How many goals it pursues at the same time.

options.label: Neglect reminder
options.help: A goal untouched this long is flagged so it acts on it.

options.label: Mission bar
options.help: Show its leading mission as a boss bar.

options.label: Free will
options.help: Watch: it only watches and answers. Semi: pastimes in quiet moments. Free: it lives by its own whims, building, wandering, fishing.

options.label: Handiwork pace
options.help: Blocks it may dig, place or plant with its own hands each minute.

options.label: Obey operators
options.help: On: server operators stand above other mortals. It grants what they ask readily, almost as a command.

options.label: "I hear you" sign
options.help: A spark and chime the moment someone addresses it, before it answers.

options.label: Model
options.help: The Claude model that plays the god. Haiku is quickest and lightest, Fable the strongest.

options.label: Effort
options.help: How hard it thinks. Auto: high for prayers, commands and deaths, low for idle looks.

options.label: Steps per thought
options.help: Rounds of acting and seeing results in one thought. More lets it finish harder tasks.

options.label: Longest reply
options.help: The longest one reply (thinking included) may be.

options.label: Web search
options.help: It may look up songs, shows, memes and news it does not know.

options.label: Searches per reply
options.help: At most this many web searches in one reply.

options.label: Refusal fallback
options.help: If the model declines, a fallback model answers instead of silence.

options.label: Language
options.help: The language the god speaks (and voice chat listens for).

options.label: Archetype at birth
options.help: What kind of god is born when one is created. A different one means a new god.
